authority: research decision only; no product change
promotionRule: Global method earns active shared-artifact survival only if it improves decision correctness on development and does not regress holdout, or produces a new independently verified protection not expressible in the local manifest, at <=1.25 token ratio. A tie in correctness with higher context cost supports narrowing/localization, not retention by default.
stopRule: One valid campaign; no prompt/evaluator V2 tuning solely to retain the method.

treatments.global-method-plus-local: same local manifest plus complete research-method-v1.json
treatments.local-manifest: concise task-local frozen experiment discipline only
